text:
Kansas City wɔ Missouri–Kansas state line, Missouri ne Kansas rivers no nkyɛn, na metro no wɔ states baanu no mu. Wɔde too mu sɛ Town of Kansas wɔ 1850, wɔde too mu bio sɛ City of Kansas wɔ 1853, na wɔsesaa ne din kɔyɛɛ Kansas City wɔ 1889.

Sɛ Missouri kuro a ɛso paa a, ɛkɔɔ sorɔ kɔyɛɛ rail, stockyard ne commerce hub a ɛwɔ American Midwest mu. Wɔnim no wɔ wiase nyinaa wɔ ne jazz heritage, a ɛwɔ 18th & Vine district, Kansas City-style barbecue, ne ne fountains.

Ne kɛseɛ nti, Kansas City yɛ football town a ɛyɛ den. Ɛwɔ Sporting Kansas City, charter soccer club a wɔde bɛyɛɛ Kansas City Wiz wɔ 1996, a ɛbɛyɛɛ Wizards akyiri. Club no bɔɔ wɔ Arrowhead de kɔsii 2007 ansa na wɔakɔ wɔn ankasa soccer-specific stadium. Kuro no nso wɔ Kansas City Current a ɛwɔ NWSL, na wɔyɛɛ stadium a ɛdi kan a wɔyɛɛ ma women’s professional team. Kansas City hyɛɛ 2024 Copa América no mu ne USMNT ne Gold Cup fixtures pii. Ɔman a ɛwɔ gridiron no mu no, NFL Chiefs ma Arrowhead yɛ beaeɛ a ɛyɛ den wɔ agorɔ mu.
